title: Blue Lions Formation
prompt:
Byleth calmly gestures students into position. Dimitri listens near the center, Dedue holds the defensive side, Felix looks impatient, Sylvain stays loose, Ashe watches for ranged instructions, Annette and Mercedes stay together, Ingrid checks the flank. Keep motion small and tactical.

Camera: medium-wide orbit or subtle push. Identity locks: Dimitri is a blond 17-year-old student prince in Blue Lions academy uniform, not king or armor. Dedue is tall dark-skinned with short white hair and shield/guard posture. Felix is dark-blue-haired tied-back duelist in black vest with white sleeves, stern and impatient. Sylvain has tousled red-orange hair and relaxed spear-student posture. Ashe has pale ash-gray hair, blue hooded layer, and bow. Annette is petite with peach-orange hair, straight bangs, curled side pigtails, nervous mage posture. Mercedes has blonde long side ponytail, white cravat, cream shawl trim, gentle healer presence, not matronly. Ingrid is blonde disciplined lance student with blue tights, checking the flank. Use formation roles and silhouettes rather than inventing generic uniformed students.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.

Dedue body lock: Dedue must be very tall, broad-shouldered, thick-chested and powerfully built, a calm shield-wall guardian beside Dimitri, not a slim student.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No blood, gore, lethal impact, battlefield carnage, or real injury. Avoid: shouting, chaotic running, face swaps. Avoid generic uniformed crowd, wrong hair colors, everyone wearing the same blue cape, war-phase armor, older king Dimitri, adult matron Mercedes, red-haired Felix, blond Sylvain, missing Ashe bow, missing Ingrid lance. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging. No skinny Dedue, no narrow shoulders, no average schoolboy body, no ordinary slim soldier build.
